2609.01146.title: StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization
2609.01146.paper_summary: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.
2609.01146.paper_summary_zh: 染色標準化減少了由於染色程序和成像條件變化所引起的顏色變化，從而提高了計算機輔助診斷系統的性能。傳統方法通過逐像素變換從單個或有限的參考圖像中推導映射關係，提供了風格靈活性，但在顏色映射提取方面存在不準確的問題。雖然現有的基於深度學習的方法通過複雜的神經網絡實現了準確的數據集範圍顏色映射，但它們面臨著計算效率低下、產生伪影以及固定標準化方向需要模型重新訓練以應對方向變化等挑戰。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了StainPresetNet——一個新穎的框架，結合了結構保護和數據集級別的顏色映射，同時保持計算效率。我們的方法實現了由預設參考圖像引導的逐像素標準化，實現了多方向的適應性而無需重新訓練。在細胞病理學和組織病理學數據集上的評估表明，StainPresetNet在顏色映射準確性上優於傳統方法，有效提高了診斷任務中分類器的泛化能力，並將計算開銷降低了90\%，相較於現有的深度學習方法。所提出的預設引導機制通過簡單的參考圖像替換，促進了標準化方向的靈活調整，克服了當前基於深度學習解決方案的方向剛性。
